name: delete-comment
description: Purge comments from a codebase: classify each as tautology, stale, excuse, or decision record; delete them, file issues for excuses, and move decisions into ADRs or tests; then ban new comments with a per-file lint ratchet and measure the lines removed. Use when asked to delete, ban, or audit every comment in a codebase or directory, move comment rationale into ADRs, add a no-comments lint rule or ratchet, or estimate the lines saved.
